ovw.title: Overview
ovw.description: How exposed you are, whether it is getting better, and what to fix first.

noData.none: There are no numbers to show
noData.afterFirst: The numbers appear after the first read from Falcon.
noData.steps: Create an API client in the customer's Falcon, add the CID, test the connection and save it in Settings > Organizations.
noData.ask: Ask your TENIX SOC to set up the Falcon connection.

a.title: Fix now (P1)
a.note: Exploited for real, or Critical that ExPRT also rates Critical
a.howTitle: Risk level = share of hosts that have a P1
a.inputs: Now: {hosts} hosts with a P1 of {total} = {share}.
a.escalationRule: One level higher when a P1 KEV past its CISA due date sits on an internet-facing host.
a.standard: This is the 10CYBER standard, not a CrowdStrike value. Filter tier = P1 on the list to reproduce it.
a.sayNone: No P1 findings were found. Keep patching on the regular cycle.
a.sayDown: {hosts} hosts ({share}) have vulnerabilities that are exploited or very likely to be. Down {change} from last week. Start with the fixes listed next to this.
a.sayUp: {hosts} hosts ({share}) have vulnerabilities that are exploited or very likely to be. Up {change} from last week. Start with the fixes listed next to this.
a.sayFlat: {hosts} hosts ({share}) have vulnerabilities that are exploited or very likely to be. Start with the top fixes in the list.
a.factsNote: KEV, Exploited and ExPRT count findings (one CVE on one device = one finding) and are exact counts from Falcon.
